desc:
Welcome to a Peppa Pig Horror Game! 🏬 
LIKE 👍+ FAVOURITE ⭐ + JOIN GROUP for a FREE Toy Gun in-game! 🔫

Peppa pig turned evil! After getting another sibling she wants revenge for everybody ignoring her. She does something evil every day. You're her next victim, don't let her get you! 

 👻 There is 3 Endings! Try to unlock them all!
 🤝 This game is Multiplayer, invite your friends!
 🛒 Check out the shop for fun items to troll your friends with!

Dont mind these: midnight, fears, ironbark, fanthom, lookout, of, cultist, peppa pig, annoying nightshift, oink oink

Inspired by Peppa Pig were just a fan game!!!
